title: marketing
text:
marketing

Maya Chen: Hey design 1 we need a quick visual pack for the product launch webinar on Wed. Small deliverables: 1) one-sheet hero (web + print sizes), 2) two-panel benchmark diagram (latency vs cost), 3) 3 social tile variants. Brand-safe, accessible colors, and copy locked by EOD Monday.
Sam Patel: timeline check 1 Wed webinar means pressable assets by Tuesday morning, right? can do if we get copy + data today. :clock1:
Maya Chen: correct 1 Tuesday AM is the hard deadline. Priority: hero one-sheet > benchmark diagram > tiles. use the short headline: “Inference that scales — predictably.” Will share more copy in a sec.
Kevin Liu: sharing the benchmark numbers now 1 99th p50 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and model variants. snippet: `latency_ms: [12, 20, 35], cost_per_1k_usd: [0.09, 0.05, 0.03]` 1 want these visualized as sparklines + callouts.
Olivia Park: FYI design check 1 we should use the new compact template (Figma file ID: fiGmA-Compact-2025). Also need alt text for each image and accessible color contrast.
Maya Chen: tagging @Sam for copy 1 Sam can you paste the short bullets here? also we need 16:9 + A4 export sizes.
Sam Patel: copy drop: 1) Headline: Inference that scales — predictably. 2) Subhead: Same API, multiple deployment modes for consistent latency and unit economics. 3) 3 bullets: Hosted API for speed; Dedicated for predictability; Private for compliance. Short CTA: Join our webinar Wed, register: https://redwood.example/webinar.
Olivia Park: can design follow brand guardrails on imagery? we prefer illustrated GPUs (no real faces), limited palette, and the new icon set. I'll DM the icon set link.
Maya Chen: yes illustrated GPUs only. Also add a small badge: "SLA-backed" and a tiny note: "numbers from internal perf lab, Apr 2025".
design-bot: Task created: MS-3872 — "Webinar visual pack (hero, benchmark diagram, tiles)" assigned to Olivia Park. Due: 2025-04-01T09:00Z. :white_check_mark:
Olivia Park: starting comps now, will post Figma link in this thread when ready (expect first pass in 4-5 hours).
Kevin Liu: quick ask for the benchmark diagram 1 prefer the x-axis: cost, y-axis: latency, three model points with labels (open, quantized, Redwood-optimized). Also include a tiny legend.
Maya Chen: perfect. if anyone sees conflicts with brand, call it out now, otherwise ship compact variants only (no long hero). :sparkles:
Sam Patel: I'll do final QA on copy when comps are up. thanks team!
Olivia Park: Figma link (WIP): https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/compact-webinar-pack — comments enabled.
